task: Pick up the cereal box from the top of the shelf and place it under the shelf.

intervals.start: The gripper has not yet grabbed the cereal box, and its tip is about 3 cm away from the cereal box.
intervals.end: The gripper closes and has just fully gripped the cereal box, slightly lifting it up.

intervals.start: The gripper is holding the cereal box and about to place it under the shelf.
intervals.end: The gripper releases the cereal box so that it now rests under the shelf.
